values.note: 30 level sites, 35x50 ft and up. Per-site limits for motorhomes: most take a Class C up to 30 ft, site 21 to 32 ft, site 17 to 35 ft (and a 25-ft Class A); site 15 only to 24 ft; site 9's access is not suitable for motorhomes. Several pull-throughs. Campspot: 'Motorhomes are limited to 30ft. For any vehicle longer than this, please contact the park directly.' One family per site.

values.note: Modern service building with hot and cold water, flush toilets and showers; dump station with step-on cover. Grills and portable fire pits only, no open fires.

values.note: Book on Campspot or by phone; the operator's own site takes calls and a quote-request form ('THIS IS NOT A RESERVATION'). 2027 reservations open January 3, 2027 (Campspot listed nothing for June 2027 on 2026-10-25). Long-term and seasonal sites through the park manager. Cancellation 15+ days out: full refund less $30; 8-14 days: 50%; under 8 days: none. Check-in 2 p.m., check-out 11 a.m.

note: Small RV park on M-75 a mile from Boyne Mountain Resort (1890 S M-75, Boyne City); a paved hiking/biking trail 600 ft west of the entrance runs to Boyne Falls and Boyne City. Mini nature preserve. --Claude
summary: Operator site + Campspot: basic rates $45-75 (was $44-69; undated, 2027 season announced), 30 sites with 20/30-amp electric, 10 full hookup (hookups added), Class C to 30 ft on most sites and 35 ft on one (max_rig_ft 35, pull-throughs), flush toilets/showers/dump, season May 15 - Oct 15 (2027), reservable on Campspot (confirmed; 2027 bookings open Jan 3) or by phone. Phone 231-549-2214 matches. Presence: working site with phone, Campspot listing (4.2 over 12). Gate: base $45 < $50 (nearest gateway Mackinaw City 68 km; family has not stayed).
